ruleRoutingGuidance.belongs: map rendering with the Leaflet library — map init options, tile layers, markers and divIcons, CDN plugin pinning
ruleRoutingGuidance.excludes: generic HTML markup rules — that is html; non-map dependency policy belongs to node

marker: a Leaflet reference (CDN asset, or an L.map/L.tileLayer/L.markerClusterGroup call) in HTML/JS source
